title: BIP Fusion Decision Schema
description: Schema for platform fusion propositions and owner-approved fusion decisions.

decision_id.description: Unique immutable fusion decision identifier (e.g. FUS-000001).

title.description: Concise summary title of the fusion decision.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the fusion decision.

target_subsystems.description: Family OS subsystems receiving this capability (e.g. S1-01, S1-08).

source_resource_refs.description: List of benchmark resources being synthesized.

rationale.description: Engineering and architectural justification for this decision.

reuse_pattern.description: Legal and technical pattern of reuse.

ip_and_legal_boundary.description: Documentation of cleanroom boundaries, license boundaries, and compliance warranties.

decision_ref.description: Official Decision ID (e.g. D-xxx) if ratified.
